title: is this a MAGNificent recipe??
description:
Who DOESN’t love a magnum bar ??!

I sure do, and if I can have it as a high-fibre, high-protein, high YUM breakfast, then sign me UP please 🥳 

I just want to clarify that of course, this isn’t going to taste like a Magnum, so please be aware of that, but it is a very fun, healthy, and delicious recipe to try !

✨recipe✨
200g of thick greek yoghurt or skyr 
10g of cocoa powder 
optional: 15g of chocolate protein powder (I used double chocolate custard from @musclenationofficial code JULES)
30g of chia seeds
splash of vanilla extract
pinch of salt
syrup to taste (i used maple; also recommend using blended dates for some extra fudginess 🤭)

for the yoghurt layer:
70g of yoghurt
1 tsp maple syrup

20-25g of melted dark chocolate 

**if you don’t have protein, i recommend using vanilla yoghurt for extra sweetness

Mix the ingredients for the chia pudding (can add a bit of milk if you don’t like it as thick!) then refrigerate for 2-3 hours.

Transfer to a jar/bowl, then make the yoghurt layer and spread over the top. melt the chocolate and drizzle over the top to form a shell.

Refrigerate overnight and enjoy!

#chiapudding #healthybreakfast #proteinbreakfast #chiaseeds
